concept: DMS: DB migration with CDC and minimal downtime
tests: Choosing a service to migrate a large on-premises DB with continuous change replication until cutover.
expected: AWS DMS: full load + ongoing replication (change data capture) → cutover with near-zero downtime. Triggers: "minimal downtime", "continuously replicating ongoing changes until cutover".
why_not: Snowball — one-time transfer without continuous replication; S3 multipart upload — for objects; DataSync — files/objects, not transactional DB changes.
